issues.legal_issue: A landowner cannot use a statutory right to evict a tenant and resume possession of land after the land has been declared surplus under a scheme that reserves its use to the state.
material_facts: The land had been declared surplus under the applicable land-tenure scheme.
The landowner had acquired the land before the surplus declaration and was a small landowner in relation to the tenants.
The landowner later sought to evict the tenants and recover possession under the statutory provision allowing eviction by a small landowner.
The scheme empowered the state to use surplus land to resettle tenants and left the landowner with a right to receive rent from tenants settled there.
issues.conclusion: The landowner could not evict the tenants and resume possession of the land, so the application for possession was properly dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 2(5a), 9(1)(i), and 10-A(a) and (b) of the Punjab Security of Land Tenures Act, 1953, once land is declared surplus, the state controls its utilization for tenant resettlement and the landowner retains only the right to receive rent from tenants settled on it. The resumption contemplated by Section 9(1)(i) is unavailable where the landowner has no right to utilize or possess the surplus land. The Court noted Section 8 and Section 12(3) of the Haryana Ceiling on Land Holdings Act, 1972, and the Full Bench decision in Smt. Jaswant Kaur v. State of Haryana, but held that even if the earlier transfer was protected from vesting under that Act, the landowner still could not resume possession under the 1953 Act.

rule.if: tenant_eviction_proceeding and land_declared_surplus and state_controls_surplus_land_use and owner_seeks_tenant_eviction

predicates.tenant_eviction_proceeding: A landowner initiated a proceeding seeking to remove a tenant and recover possession of land.
predicates.land_declared_surplus: The land had been declared surplus under the applicable land-tenure scheme.
predicates.state_controls_surplus_land_use: The governing scheme assigned use of declared surplus land to the state and left the landowner with a right to receive rent from tenants settled on it.
predicates.owner_seeks_tenant_eviction: The landowner sought to evict a tenant and resume possession of the land.

issues.definition: When a landowner seeks tenant eviction in a proceeding concerning land declared surplus whose use is controlled by the state, the landowner cannot resume possession by evicting the tenant.
